description: Synthetic Category contract case: low value procurement.

candidates.title: Metro awards small contract for station fare readers
candidates.search_snippet: The operator awarded a formal contract for replacement fare readers at two stations.
candidates.source_content: The operator awarded a formal contract for replacement fare readers at two stations. The notice confirms the supplier and a USD 180,000 amount. The small amount affects Reportability independently and does not change the procurement category.

contract_notes: The formal supplier award determines PROCUREMENT even though the amount is below USD 3M.
Reportability independently returns NOT_REPORTABLE for this low-value event.
Category and Reportability remain separate owner decisions.
